name: Automations
description: Multi-stage automation engine: multi-triggers, nested conditions, branching actions, delays, loops, parallel runs, voice confirmations, and execution tracing.
capabilities: Triggers: schedule, intervals, sunrise/sunset offsets, device state changes, presence, vocal commands, system events, webhooks
Nested conditions (AND/OR/NOT): time windows, presence, day/night mode, quiet hours, logical expressions
Actions: Home Assistant devices, TTS speech, notifications, widgets, hologram, sound effects, agent tools, HTTP requests
Control flow: if/else, multi-branch switch, parallel branches, loops, timeouts, voice confirmation
Contextual variables, Jinja expressions, queue/parallel execution modes
Natural language automation authoring with automated validation, templates, and import/export
Execution history with detailed step traces, latency breakdown, and cancellation controls
